chapter.verse: Ni sagih lakah ni kipat ni zingtungin numeite in amau bawlsa paknamtui tawi-in hanah a pai uh hi.
Han vang pan suang kilikkhia a, om mu uh a,
a sungah a tum uh leh, Zeisu’ luang a mu kei uh hi.
Amaute in lamdang a sak lai takun, mi nih in mit leng thei puan silhin amaute kiangah a ding uh hi.
Numeite in kihta ahih manunah boksukin a om lai takun tua tangvalte in, “Note in misite lakah a nungta mi bang hangin zong na hi uh hiam?
Hih lai takah om nawn lo hi.
A thokik zo hi. Mihing Tapa in migilote khut sungah kipia-in, singlamteh tungah kithat ding a, nithum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi,’ ci-in Galile gamah a om lai-in,
note hong hilhna thu ngaihsun un,” a cih uh ciangin numeite in a phawk kik uh hi.
Han pan paikhia uh a, tua thu khempeuh sawm-le-khatte akipan adang Christiante kiangah a ko uh hi.
Tua numeite in Magdalene khua Mari leh Joanna leh Jeim’ nu Mari te ahi uh hi. Numei dangte in tuate tawh tua thu sawltakte kiangah a ko khawm uh hi.
Sawltakte in tua thute a mawkna thu sa uh a, a um kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Piter tho-in hanah a tai hi. A tun’ ciangin kumsuka a et leh, saihadial puan bek a muh ciangin tua banga piangte lamdangsa-in innah a ciah hi.
Tua ni-in Christian nih Jerusalem khuapi pan tai giat a kigamla Emmaus kici khua-ah a pai uh hi.
Tua lai takin a piangsa thu khempeuh khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
A kikup lai takun Zeisu in va nai a, amaute tawh a paikhawm hi.
Amaute in Zeisu ahih lam a theih loh nadingun a mit uh a mang hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in lam na pai lai takun na kikup uh thu in bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, maikhingin a khawl uh hi.
Tuate khat Kleopas kici in, “Jerusalem khuapi-ah hawh napi-in tulai taka tua khua a, thu piangte khempeuh thei lo nang bek na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Zeisu in, “Bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-a a dot leh, tua pa in, “Nazareth mi Zeisu’ thu ahi hi. Tua pa in Pasian mai-ah ahi zongin, mite mai-ah ahi zongin, kam siamna leh khut siamna tawh a dim kamsangpa ahi hi.
Siampi liante leh ei upate in tua pa a sih nadingin pia uh a, singlamteh tungah a that uh hi.
Tua pa in Israel pawlte tan dingpa ahi hi ci-in kote in ka lamen uh hi. Tua tham loin, hih thu khempeuh a pian’ zawh ni thum pha zo hi.
Ko pawlpi numei kimkhatte zingtungin hanah pai uh a,
a luang a muh loh uh ciangin hong pai uh a, ‘Zeisu a nungta zo hi,’ ci-a a gen vantungmite a kilang a muh thu hong gen uh a, lamdang ka sa uh hi.
Tua lai takin kote lakah mi kimkhatte hanah pai uh a, numeite’ gen mah bangin a muh uh hangin Zeisu a mu kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Kamsangte hong genkholh thu khempeuh up nadinga pilna nei lote aw,
Zeisu in hih bang teng thuakin minthan’na a ngah nading thu om lo ahi hiam?” a cih khit ciangin,
Moses leh kamsangte khempeuh pan akipan, Lai Siangtho sungah amah a cihnopna thute tel takin a hilh hi.
Amaute in a paina khua a naih uh ciangin, Zeisu in tua khua paisan ding bangin a pai leh,
amaute in, “Kote tawh hong giakkhawm in. Ni tumin khua a mial dek zo hi,” ci-in Zeisu nakpi-in a khoh uh ciangin, amah in amaute tawh giakkhawm dingin inn sungah a lut hi.
Sabuai-ah amaute tawh a tutkhawm lai takin khomun la a, hehpihna a phat khit khit ciangin khomun balneenin a pia hi.
Tua lai takin amaute’ mit kihong a, Zeisu ahih lam a thei uh a; tua ciangin amau kiang panin amah a mang hi.
Amaute in, “Lampi-ah eite hong hilh a, Lai Siangtho thu hong gen lai takin, i dip kuasak hilo ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kiho uh hi.
Tua hun lai takin amaute tho uh a, Jerusalem khuapi-ah a ciahkik uh a, sawm-le-khatte a lawmte tawh kikhawm a om a mu uh hi.
Tuate in, “Topa thokik takpi a, Simon kiangah a kilang hi,” a cih uh ciangin,
amaute in zong lampi-ah thu piang khempeuh leh khomun a balnen lai takin a kilakna thu a gen uh hi.
Tua thu a gen lai takun Zeisu amaute lai zangah ding a, “Nopna ngah ta un,” a cih ciangin;
amaute in sikha sa uh a, kigaihin a lau uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Bang hangin lauin lungmang na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin na lungsim sung uh ah up khialhna na nei uh hiam?
Ka khut hong en un la, ka khe zong en un. Kei pumpi mahmah ahih lam hong en un la, na khut uh tawh hong lawng un.
Nong muh uh bangin guh leh sa ka nei hi; sikha in a nei kei hi,” ci-in a khut leh khe a lak hi.
Amaute in lamdang sa uh a, lungdam lua ahih uh ciangin um zo lo lailai-in, “Note in nek ding khatpeuh na nei uh hiam?” ci-in a dot khit ciangin;
nga emsa tum khat a pia uh hi. Tua ngasa Zeisu in la a, amaute mai-ah a ne hi.

Khatvei Zeisu in, “Moses’ Thukhamna ahi zongin, kamsangte’ gelhna thu ahi zongin, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh thu ahi zongin keima thu a kigelhsa khempeuh a tangtung ding hi ci-in ke’n note tawh ka om khop lai takin kong gen khempeuhte in hih thu ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Lai Siangtho a theih nadingun amaute lungsim a hon’sak hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in,, “Khazih in sihna thuak a, ni thum khit ciangin thokik ding a;
ama min tawh kisikkikna thu leh mawhmaisakna thu Jerusalem khua pan akipan mi pawl khempeuhte’ kiangah a kigen ding hi ci-in kigelh hi.
Hih thute-ah teci na hi uh hi.
Pa’ thuciamna kong pia ding hi. Ahih hangin vantung pan vangliatna na ngah matengun, hih khua-ah na ngak lai un,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Zeisu in amaute paipih a, Bethani khua pam a tun’ uh ciangin a khut lamto-in thupha a pia hi.
Tua bang a thupha a piak lai takin, amaute tawh kikhen a, vantungah kilato hi.
Amaute in Zeisu a biak khit uh ciangin lungdamna tampi tawh Jerusalem khua-ah ciah uh a;
Pasian’ min phatin biakna innpi sungah a pai tawntung uh hi.
